meowth-alola.description: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They’re prideful and crafty.

meowth-galar.description: Uhhh kinda looks like where the wild things are.

persian-alola.description: Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the most high-class velvet—have made this a very popular Pokémon in Alola.

rattata-alola.description: It shows no interest in anything that isn’t fresh. If you take it shopping with you, it will help you pick out ingredients.

raticate-alola.description: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.

sandshrew-alola.description: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

sandslash-alola.description: This is Sandslash’s form after adaptation to a frigid environment. The cold air emitted by its body sharpens its icy spikes.

vulpix-alola.description: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

ninetales-alola.description: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain’s base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

raichu-alola.description: It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It hops aboard its own tail, using psychic power to lift the tail and move about while riding it.

diglett-alola.description: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

dugtrio-alola.description: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It’s reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

geodude-alola.description: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

graveler-alola.description: When it comes rolling down a mountain path, anything in its way gets zapped by electricity and sent flying.

golem-alola.description: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn’t fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

muk-alola.description: The garbage it eats causes continuous chemical changes in its body, which produce its exceedingly vivid coloration.

exeggutor-alola.description: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

marowak-alola.description: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

ponyta-galar.description: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon’s horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

rapidash-galar.description: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

slowpoke-galar.description: Although this Pokémon is normally always spacing out, its expression occasionally sharpens. This seems to be due to the Galarica seeds it eats.

slowbro-galar.description: A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro’s body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison type.

slowking-galar.description: A combination of toxins and the shock of evolution has caused the Shellder on its head to become the dominant intelligence.

farfetchd.description: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

farfetchd-galar.description: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, stout leeks in battle.

sirfetchd.description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

weezing-galar.description: It consumes polluted air and poisonous gases for sustenance. The air it exhales after cleaning is incredibly clean.

mr-mime.description: It is a master of pantomime. It can create invisible walls by vibrating its fingertips to harden the air.

mr-mime-galar.description: Its talent is tap-dancing. It wiggles its fingers to let out a freezing coldness from the ice patterns on its belly.

mr-rime.description: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

corsola.description: In a corner of the South Sea, many live in clean seas where they can't be seen. If the sea becomes dirty, their beautiful coral colors will fade.

corsola-galar.description: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient Corsola. It absorbs others' life-force through the branches that form its body.

cursola.description: Its shell is broken, and its spirit-like body has spilled out. Be cautious—the ectoplasm that surrounds its body will stiffen anyone who touches it.

zigzagoon.description: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

zigzagoon-galar.description: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and halloos at others to provoke them.

linoone.description: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots prey, it delivers a powerful tackle while traveling at speeds over 60 mph.

linoone-galar.description: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the fight is on, it delivers devastating tackles.

obstagoon.description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. Its voice is so loud that it can make an opponent flinch with just a shout.

darumaka.description: When its internal fire burns, it cannot stay still. It runs around as if it were a ball of fire.

darmanitan-standard.description: When one gets injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like state. It then meditates to sharpen its mind.

darumaka-galar.description: It has an organ that produces cold air. The colder this organ gets, the more energetic Darumaka becomes.

darmanitan-galar-standard.description: On days when it’s cold, it comes down to villages. It’s known to store food in the snowball on its head.

yamask.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cofagrigus.description: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

details.condition: Take 49+ HP damage and walk under Stone Bridge

yamask-galar.description: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing Yamask's power.

details.condition: Take 49+ HP damage and walk under Stone Bridge

runerigus.description: A powerful curse was woven into the ancient paintings on its body. It was activated by Yamask's spirit.

stunfisk-galar.description: Living in mud with high iron content has given it a strong steel body. It has a habit of biting into anything that gets close.

articuno-galar.description: Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic energy that can leave an opponent stone-cold immobile. It is known to look down on other living beings with a chilly, haughty attitude.

zapdos-galar.description: When its feathers rub together, they produce a sound like the crackling of electricity. Since its wings are vestigial, it focuses on powerful, high-speed kicks that can pulverize boulders.

moltres-galar.description: The sinister aura that blazes like fire from its body is enough to consume the spirit of any creature it touches. It is a highly aggressive Pokémon that shows no mercy.

venusaur-mega.description: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger. The scent from its bloom is so potent it can calm the emotions of people and Pokémon alike.

charizard-mega-x.description: The overwhelming power that fills its body turns it black and creates intense blue flames. Its body temperature is so high that its breath burns with a blue-hot intensity that can melt steel.

charizard-mega-y.description: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts an incredible flying prowess that allows it to reach heights of 30,000 feet, and its fire is hot enough to turn water into steam instantly.

blastoise-mega.description: The small shells on its arms have disappeared, replaced by a single, colossal water cannon on its back. This cannon has a range of over six miles and boasts enough destructive power to blast through thick steel plates.

beedrill-mega.description: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

pidgeot-mega.description: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.

alakazam-mega.description: It has traded its physical strength for pure psychic power. It can see the entire life course of its opponent, from birth to death, in a single glance.

slowbro-mega.description: All the energy from Mega Evolution went into the Shellder on its tail. The Shellder has become an ironclad armor that is virtually impenetrable.

gengar-mega.description: It sinks into another dimension, leaving only its third eye on the surface. It can see through walls and even into the hearts of its prey.

kangaskhan-mega.description: The child in its pouch has grown up and jumped out to fight. The mother's bond gives the child the courage to face any opponent.

pinsir-mega.description: The surge of energy has caused wings to sprout on its back. It can now fly at high speeds, shredding anything in its path with its massive horns.

gyarados-mega.description: Mega Evolution has placed a massive burden on its body, making it even more violent. It uses the jets on its sides to blast through the water like a missile.

aerodactyl-mega.description: Some scholars say this is its true ancient form. Hardened stone spikes have erupted across its body due to the stress of the transformation.

mewtwo-mega-x.description: Its muscles are swollen with psychic energy, giving it unparalleled physical strength. It can exert a ton of pressure with a single punch.

mewtwo-mega-y.description: Its body has become smaller and more streamlined to maximize its mental acuity. It can crush a skyscraper with the mere thought of doing so.

sceptile-mega.description: It can cut off its own tail and fire it like a missile at an opponent. The power in its legs allows it to move faster than the eye can follow.

blaziken-mega.description: As it fights, the flames from its wrists burn more intensely. Its kicks are so powerful they can leave an opponent scorched and charred.

swampert-mega.description: The muscles in its upper body have expanded significantly. It can swim through the water as fast as a jet and crush a boulder with its bare hands.

gardevoir-mega.description: Its heart is open and exposed, manifesting its pure loyalty. It can use its tremendous psychic power to distort dimensions and create small black holes.

sableye-mega.description: The gem on its chest has detached and grown into a massive shield. No attack can scratch the jewel, but the weight makes it difficult for Sableye to move.

mawile-mega.description: It now has two massive sets of jaws on the back of its head. These jaws have a mind of their own and can tear through thick iron sheets with ease.

aggron-mega.description: The energy of Mega Evolution has turned its armor into a pure, super-hard steel. It is said to be the most defensive Pokémon in existence.

medicham-mega.description: Through meditation, its spirit has manifested as extra arms made of pure energy. It uses these to strike with blinding speed and precision.

manectric-mega.description: Its body is constantly discharging an enormous amount of electricity that it cannot fully contain. It moves as fast as a literal bolt of lightning.

sharpedo-mega.description: The yellow markings on its body are scars from previous battles. The fangs in its mouth can instantly regrow, allowing it to rip through metal ships.

camerupt-mega.description: The volcano on its back is constantly erupting. It hates water and damp places, and its body temperature is high enough to melt stone on contact.

altaria-mega.description: It is enveloped in a special plumage that glitters with a pearly sheen. It sings in a beautiful soprano voice that can mesmerize anyone who hears it.

banette-mega.description: The zippers on its body have opened, releasing an immense amount of cursed energy. It is driven by a powerful, persistent grudge.

absol-mega.description: The fur on its back stands up like wings, giving it an angelic appearance. However, it remains a harbinger of disaster and strikes with terrifying speed.

glalie-mega.description: The excessive energy has broken its jaw, leaving it unable to close its mouth. It blasts out incredibly cold air that freezes its enemies solid.

salamence-mega.description: Its two wings have fused into a single large blade. It tucks its legs into its shell to become a living, flying crescent that slices through anything.

metagross-mega.description: Four brains are joined together by a complex neural network. It calculates battle outcomes faster than a supercomputer and strikes without mercy.

latias-mega.description: It has become more aerodynamic, allowing it to fly faster than a jet. Its body is covered in a glass-like down that can refract light to make it invisible.

latios-mega.description: Its speed and intelligence have reached their peak. It can understand human speech and can fly at speeds that surpass the sound barrier.

rayquaza-mega.description: It draws power from the ozone layer to achieve this state. It can control the weather at will and is said to be the guardian of the skies.

garchomp-mega.description: Its arms have melted and reformed into giant, scythe-like blades. It is consumed by rage and will slash at anything that moves.

lucario-mega.description: The aura flowing through its body has become so intense that it leaves black streaks on its fur. It fights with a heartless and brutal efficiency.

abomasnow-mega.description: The sprouts on its back have grown into massive ice crystals. It creates perpetual blizzards to hide itself from those who would disturb its peace.

gallade-mega.description: It uses the blades on its elbows to fight like a master swordsman. It is a gentlemanly Pokémon that will risk its life to protect its trainer.

audino-mega.description: It emits a soothing aura that can calm anyone within range. Touching its feelers allows it to know the physical and mental state of others.

diancie-mega.description: It's like pink and crystally and cool and stuff.

aegislash-shield.description: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

aegislash-blade.description: This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.

zygarde-50.description: This is Zygarde’s form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.

zygarde-10.description: This is Zygarde’s form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

zygarde-complete.description: This is Zygarde’s 100% form. It has enough power to overwhelm even Xerneas or Yveltal.

venusaur-gmax.description: Huge amounts of pollen burst from it with the force of a volcanic eruption. Breathing in too much of the pollen can cause fainting.

charizard-gmax.description: This colossal, flame-winged figure of a Charizard was brought about by Gigantamax energy.

blastoise-gmax.description: In battle, it doesn’t bother to aim. Instead, it fires dynamic, powerful torrents from multiple cannons to overwhelm opponents.

butterfree-gmax.description: Crystallized Gigantamax energy makes up this Pokémon’s blindingly bright and highly toxic scales.

pikachu-gmax.description: Its Gigantamax power expanded, forming its supersized body and towering tail.

meowth-gmax.description: Its body has grown incredibly long and the coin on its forehead has grown incredibly large—all thanks to Gigantamax power.

machamp-gmax.description: The Gigantamax energy coursing through its arms makes its punches hit as hard as bomb blasts.

gengar-gmax.description: Rumor has it that its gigantic mouth leads not into its body, filled with cursed energy, but instead directly to the afterlife.

kingler-gmax.description: The flow of Gigantamax energy has spurred this Pokémon’s left pincer to grow to an enormous size. That claw can pulverize anything.

lapras-gmax.description: It surrounds itself with a huge ring of gathered ice particles. It uses the ring to smash any icebergs that might impede its graceful swimming.

eevee-gmax.description: Having gotten even friendlier and more innocent, Eevee tries to play with anyone around, only to end up crushing them with its immense body.

snorlax-gmax.description: Gigantamax energy has affected stray seeds and even pebbles that got stuck to Snorlax, making them grow to a huge size.

garbodor-gmax.description: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon’s toxic gas has become much thicker, congealing into masses shaped like discarded toys.

melmetal-gmax.description: In a distant land, there are legends about a cyclopean giant. In fact, the giant was a Melmetal that was flooded with Gigantamax energy.

rillaboom-gmax.description: Gigantamax energy has caused Rillaboom’s stump to grow into a drum set that resembles a forest.

cinderace-gmax.description: Gigantamax energy can sometimes cause the diameter of this Pokémon’s fireball to exceed 300 feet.

inteleon-gmax.description: Gigantamax Inteleon’s Water Gun move fires at Mach 7. As the Pokémon takes aim, it uses the crest on its head to gauge wind and temperature.

corviknight-gmax.description: Its brain has grown to a gargantuan size, as has the rest of its body. This Pokémon’s intellect and psychic abilities are overpowering.

drednaw-gmax.description: It responded to Gigantamax energy by becoming bipedal. First it comes crashing down on foes, and then it finishes them off with its massive jaws.

coalossal-gmax.description: Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax energy stoking the fire, this Pokémon’s flame burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

flapple-gmax.description: Under the influence of Gigantamax energy, it produces much more sweet nectar, and its shape has changed to resemble a giant apple.

appletun-gmax.description: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon’s nectar has thickened. The increased viscosity lets the nectar absorb more damage than before.

sandaconda-gmax.description: Its sand pouch has grown to tremendous proportions. More than 1,000,000 tons of sand now swirl around its body.

toxtricity-gmax.description: Its excessive electric energy is its weapon. This Pokémon can build up more electricity than any thundercloud.

centiskorch-gmax.description: Gigantamax energy has evoked a rise in its body temperature, now reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Its heat waves incinerate its enemies.

hatterene-gmax.description: Beams like lightning shoot down from its tentacles. It’s known to some as the Raging Goddess.

grimmsnarl-gmax.description: Gigantamax energy has caused more hair to sprout all over its body. With the added strength, it can jump over the world’s tallest building.

alcremie-gmax.description: It launches swarms of missiles, each made of cream and loaded with 100,000 kilocalories. Get hit by one of these, and your head will swim.

copperajah-gmax.description: After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed, its massive nose can utterly demolish large structures with a single smashing blow.

duraludon-gmax.description: The hardness of its cells is exceptional, even among Steel types. It also has a body structure that’s resistant to earthquakes.

urshifu-single-strike.description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

urshifu-rapid-strike.description: It’s believed that this Pokémon modeled its fighting style on the flow of a river—sometimes rapid, sometimes calm.

urshifu-single-strike-gmax.description: The energy released by this Pokémon’s fists forms shock waves that can blow away Dynamax Pokémon in just one hit.

urshifu-rapid-strike-gmax.description: As it waits for the right moment to unleash its Gigantamax power, this Pokémon maintains a perfect one-legged stance. It won’t even twitch.
